		AND = { kehillah_writing_talmud_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_tosafot_written } kehillah_sefer_ambition_tosafot_trigger = yes kehillah_writing_believes_thesis_trigger = { TENET = tenet_kehillah_scholarly_study } }
	}
}

		AND = { kehillah_writing_torah_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_ibn_ezra_torah_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_rabbanite_trigger = yes } learning >= 17 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_targum_onkelos } num_of_known_languages >= 3 kehillah_writing_parshanut_aptitude_value >= 45 }
		AND = { kehillah_writing_torah_trigger = yes NOT = { has_global_variable = kehillah_wk_work_ramban_torah_written } rite ?= { kehillah_rite_rabbanite_trigger = yes } learning >= 17 is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_rashi_torah } is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_ibn_ezra_torah } kehillah_writing_parshanut_aptitude_value >= 50 }

	}
